theorems.name: Submission.tae_c1_uniform_remainder
theorems.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ C : Set (Rn n), IsClosed C → C ⊆ {x | DifferentiableAt ℝ f x} → ∀ δ : ℝ≥0∞, δ ≠ 0 → ∃ A : Set (Rn n), A ⊆ C ∧ IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < δ ∧ ∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖f y - f x - fderiv ℝ f x (y - x)‖ ≤ η * ‖y - x‖
